When suggesting features or improvements, please follow the guidelines in this template. This would help us for a great understanding.

- The golden rule is to always open one issue for one feature/improvement. If you have many ideas on how new features or improvements to add, make sure to create one new issue for each of them.
- Search open and closed issues to ensure it has not already been suggested. If you don't find a relevant match or if you're unsure, don't hesitate to open a new issue. As always, the lead Dev is here to handle that for you
- tech features only: the website doesn't belong to EVA STUDIO. So we're not allowed to add or remove anything the customer wanted in the final product. The features or improvements that you can propose just need to be technically related to what we're doing. (e.g: I would really like a component that would help us much faster maintaining the website)
- If your improvement is related to a problem, then give a precise description of what the problem is. If you have some ideas about the way to do things, feel free to talk to us about it
